propositions: removal records for never-peer-confirmed managed links are incorrectly applied because managed_refs is monotonic and marks links managed at creation without distinguishing never-pushed local links from peer-deleted ones

outbound dedup on (vendor_type, target_key) without relation scoping allows a local link to never be pushed or G4-protected when its vendor type collides with an existing remote link in the opposite direction
inbound removal applier must consult peer-confirmation store before unlinking and decline removal if no confirmation exists, returning False to keep the silent-no-op canary truthful
unopenable peer-confirmation store must fail-open to preserve exactly today's removal behavior and not precondition the removal application
per-pass decline count must be reported in the existing INFO summary alongside impossible-link skips to make declines operator-visible
